variants.asks: what a body feels is what arrives and the mismatch its acceleration has piled up. What is that law - and what does it do where the field is weak?

parts.because: the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving

standing_for.name: g_{N}
standing_for.because: TWO CHANNELS, and they are not the same thing counted over. The vacuum's needs neither body to emit anything: the near one prevents an expansion, that shortfall spreads, and the far one is pushed into it because fewer rays arrive from that side. The meetings' needs both: it is the cross piece of the quadratic, one body's radiation meeting the other's, and it carries both masses. What a body feels is everything that arrives at it, and things that arrive add. AND THE EXPANSION IS NOT A THIRD: a body prevents the splitting around it, and that one missing making is read as room that never appeared where there is nothing in the way, and as something arriving where there is. Asking what force a body feels puts a body in the way, so it is the second reading - counting both would count one shortfall twice

standing_for.name: a_{0}
standing_for.because: THE SCALE IS THE EMPTY VACUUM'S OWN GROWTH, v H_{\Lambda}, and it is the same at every place and every epoch. Read at the place, as the growth the matter there makes, it would change gravity where it is best measured (a planet's orbit) by far more than it allows unless the world's matter is too thin to lift anything; read as the age, or as the whole world's growth rate, a_{0} was three to four times larger at z = 2 and Genzel's six discs would carry dark fractions of 0.3 where they carry at most 0.2 - so neither. What does not change with the matter or the age is the vacuum's own growth, the rate at which its beat, left to itself, grows points: that is H_{\Lambda}, and a_{0} = v H_{\Lambda}. Measured, a_{0}/cH_{0} = v \sqrt{\Omega_{\Lambda}}, a coincidence of this epoch. It was read before as: WHAT ENDS THE ACCUMULATION IS THE BEGINNING, not a meeting. A meeting ends a CARRIER, and the mean free path is how far one gets - but nothing of a body's rays is ended by the vacuum it rides through: what is sent at a distance is what was sent, spread, and the medium carries it as far as there is medium (`Medium` streams a body's rays with no absorption at all, and the pull it gives falls as the shell does and no faster). The phase, though, is counted in TICKS against the vacuum's own beat, and there have only ever been so many of them: the frontier grows one cell a tick, so the age is t_{0} = 1/H and the longest a mismatch can have been piling up is that. So the scale is v over the age, which is vH - and a_{0}/cH comes out as v itself, a count of the tiling and nothing else

standing_for.name: the vacuum's channel
standing_for.because: the near body prevents an expansion, that shortfall spreads, and the far one is pushed into it because fewer rays arrive from that side. NEITHER BODY HAS TO EMIT ANYTHING for this one - it is the making that did not happen, carried out to R and met by whatever is open to it

standing_for.name: the meetings' channel
standing_for.because: the cross piece of the quadratic: one body's radiation meeting the other's. It needs BOTH to be shining, which is why it carries both masses and the motion factor twice

standing_for.name: \omega
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. `outward` finds the point across the way, and where that point has been folded it follows it through to the hub it was folded into - so a way that led somewhere still does, hub or point. It comes back with nothing only where there is no point across the way at all, which is the edge of a finite world. The vacuum the line is written in is infinite: every way has a point across it, and the share of ways with room ahead is all of them

standing_for.name: n_{f}
standing_for.because: a meeting leaves a fold and a creation over a held point takes one off, so what a place has swallowed is not a tally that only grows - it settles where its own line nets nought. THE LINE NETTING NEGATIVE DOES NOT MEAN THE LEVEL IS NOUGHT: the vacuum is working the whole time, and what stands is the rate folds are written over the rate one is cleared. The line is linear in the record, so that is a quotient and not a search - and at the settled density, where the making pays for the taking, it comes to DEG/2: one fold for every two ways, the record the vacuum keeps of its own. A BODY ADDS TO IT: what it prevents spreads, and an accumulation of what arrives is one power weaker than the flux. `turns` draws on the sum, so both belong

standing_for.name: \sigma
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. a rewrite fires on every match it has, once a tick - that is what a rule of this model is. So its rate is ONE per match per tick, and the name on it says which rewrite rather than how often: there is nothing here to choose or to fit

standing_for.name: F
standing_for.because: the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving

standing_for.name: \rho
standing_for.because: and the density the line's own terms carry IS that settled one, everywhere the line is about the vacuum rather than about a source - so a law written in terms of the density can be written in terms of the rates instead

standing_for.name: l.reach\paren{\bar{R}}
standing_for.because: a ray on a heading is taken at one over the free path per step, so the share of what set out that is still on that heading R steps later is one less that, to the R. It is a count of the rays themselves and nothing else: a meeting that takes a ray writes a fold, and the fold is carried by the record and read back out by creation - so this is the NEAR field, the direct arrival, and it is what a body's own cells shadow one another by. Beyond a free path the body is still there, as record

standing_for.name: \bar{r}
standing_for.because: the separation is what the pair has and neither body does - and it is not `R`, which in `massOf` is a body's own thickness. Two lengths that never met until a law was written with a mass in it

standing_for.name: met(R)
standing_for.because: the cross piece of the quadratic is one body's radiation meeting the other's, summed along the line between them. Each body's thins as the shell grows, so the product is large only near one of them - and how near is bounded by a step, which is the only length the lattice has. Two ends, each contributing the far density times the near sum cut off at one step. AND EACH END CARRIES A DOPPLER FACTOR, which is not put in: one cell a tick makes a distance a time, a body crosses \beta of a cell a tick, so two rays sent a tick apart land 1 - \beta\cdot\hat{d} ticks apart and what arrives per tick is the reciprocal. That is the classical factor, derived from the two rules and directional because only the motion ALONG the line changes when a ray gets there

standing_for.name: \bar{c}
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - the term + \sigma \paren{1 - \omega}n of the continuous model: 0 rays a firing, at rate \sigma, on the share 1 - \omega of the matches, of degree 1 in the density; what this fact takes from it is below. every active ray goes ONE CELL along its own exit in one tick, which is what the streaming term says - so a step is one cell, and that is the only length the lattice has to measure anything else against

standing_for.name: \mathcal{D}
standing_for.because: ONE MOTION, TWO EFFECTS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS HERE. `EMISSION` is gated on `spare = not(moving)`, so a tick spent crossing a cell is a tick not spent shining and a body emits on 1 - \beta of its ticks - THE SAME IN EVERY DIRECTION, so that is how much the body sends and it is already in the mass, inside the source's own choice, `l.choose\paren{\bar{m}_{x·l.DEG·\paren{1 - \beta}}}`. WHAT IS DIRECTIONAL IS THE OTHER HALF: `MOVEMENT` gives one cell a tick, so a distance IS a time, and between two emissions a tick apart the body has closed \beta\cdot\hat{d} of the way to wherever the ray is going - they land that much closer together and what arrives per tick is the reciprocal. IT IS THE CLASSICAL DOPPLER FACTOR and nothing about waves or observers went into it. A body blocks the vacuum's making whether it moves or not, so this is on the meeting term and nowhere else

standing_for.name: \delta n_{f}
standing_for.because: what a body ADDS to the fold record, over what the vacuum settles to on its own. The settled part is everywhere alike and is the vacuum's own index; this is the part that depends on where you are relative to a body, and it is what a metric is

standing_for.name: l.\bar{m}
standing_for.because: READ OFF THE CONTINUOUS MODEL - not one term of it but all of them, since this is about how the line is made. the line is written at a local, l, and what a source puts in there is its mass - a choice over that local's ways out: which of its l.DEG exits it lights, at \bar{m}_{x} apiece, on the ticks its own rule leaves it. The gate the rule asked of the source is inside the choice because it is a statement about which exits, and the line carries nothing of the source but this

steps.because: the rules, read as a line: every rule of the theory is a term, the reading having run each rule's program on a symbolic match and counted what it does to the population - what it makes, what it takes, what it carries, what a body puts in - so the line is what the rules come to as a crowd rather than a description of them. Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

steps.via: what is felt, with the mismatch closed
working: strong: g \to g_{N};  weak: g \to \sqrt{g_{N}a_{0}}, so v^{4} = G m a_{0} at D = 3
steps.because: what is felt is what arrives, g_{N}, and the mismatch an acceleration has piled up on it, measured against the vacuum's own rate: a_{0}/g of it. So g = g_{N}\paren{1 + a_{0}/g}, with g on both sides because what a body accelerates at is what it feels - and solved, a strong field gives the arrival back and a weak one the geometric mean of the arrival and the scale, \sqrt{g_{N}a_{0}}: g_{N} falls as the shell, so its root falls one power of the distance in three dimensions and a speed on a circle stops falling

derivation.via: the scale is the vacuum's own growth
working: CREATION: fires at a free point, lights every way - the vacuum pulses, every other tick
EMISSION: a source moves or emits, so each move flips the parity, fore against aft
steady: the flips cancel; accelerating: they pile up, since the beginning
the age is one over the vacuum's growth, \frac{1}{t}
derivation.because: CREATION fires only at a free point and lights every way of it, so the vacuum pulses: a point fires, its rays leave, and it is free again the tick after. EMISSION sends only on the ticks a source stands - it moves or it emits - so whether what it sends meets the vacuum's lit half or its dark half is a parity, and every tick it moves flips it, the opposite way fore and aft. At a steady speed the flips cancel; while it accelerates they do not, and nothing has cut them off since the world began: they have piled up over the age, one over the rate the vacuum grows at. Carried at what a heading keeps straight, that is a rate of its own - the scale an acceleration is measured against

working: the draw: 1 straight on against n_{f} folded
derivation.because: MOVEMENT draws a ray straight on at one against every fold its place holds, so what a heading keeps of itself a step is one over one more than the record - and far from every body the record is the settled one, half the lattice's ways. It is the share of a step that goes where it was going: the speed a carrier's heading is carried at

derivation.via: the record settled against the density
derivation.because: the record's line is linear in the record: a meeting writes a fold whatever l holds, a creation takes one off every way that holds one, and the more folds l holds the more ways it has to write them on. Where the record has stopped moving the line is nought, and it says what the record is at a density. It settles: the record's slope in its own line is what a creation takes back less what the extra way gives the meetings, and at the settled density that is below nought

derivation.via: the world grows at its frontier
working: at the frontier: MOVEMENT at 1 - \omega, one cell a tick
derivation.because: so what grows the world is the frontier alone: a ray with nowhere to step makes the room and steps into it, the same tick - a ray never waits. The frontier advances a cell a tick, so a world grown from a point is as wide as it is old, R = \bar{c}t, and its rate of growth is one over its age: H = \dot{R}/R = 1/t. It is not a constant: it thins as the world ages, a coasting expansion, and today it is one over the age

working: MOVEMENT grows at 1 - \omega: nought where every ray has room ahead
derivation.because: the growth ledger read where the vacuum has settled: every ray there has room ahead, so MOVEMENT grows nothing and no meeting leaves a point behind a vacuum ray. The empty vacuum grows no space of its own - there is no constant in these rules that thins nothing

a firing that makes a point no local held - behind a ray at a meeting, ahead of a ray with nowhere to step - grows the world by it, at its own rate, through its own gates, the count written on it. This is the room the world gains per local per tick: what it expands by
